title: Nextdoor to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: Nextdoor will participate in investor conferences on September 9 and 10, 2026, to discuss business and financial performance with stakeholders.
body_markdown:
SAN FRANCISCO--([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )--


Nextdoor Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: NXDR), the essential neighborhood network, today announced its participation in the following investor conferences during the week of September 7, 2026:


- On


**Wednesday, September 9** ,


**management**


will host one-on-one investor meetings at the


**Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference in New York, New York** .
- On


**Thursday, September 10, management**


will host one-on-one investor meetings at the


**B. Riley Securities 9th Annual Consumer & TMT Conference in New York, New York.**


Nextdoor uses its Investor Relations website ([investors.nextdoor.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.nextdoor.com&esheet=54594963&newsitemid=20260827096124&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.nextdoor.com&index=1&md5=b336e3e3542777ac5490691a1a26a695) ), its X handle ([x.com/Nextdoor](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FNextdoor&esheet=54594963&newsitemid=20260827096124&lan=en-US&anchor=x.com%2FNextdoor&index=2&md5=84fcfc3244913ab91a732be0b5b02ab7) ), its LinkedIn Home Page ([linkedin.com/company/nextdoor-com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Flinkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fnextdoor-com&esheet=54594963&newsitemid=20260827096124&lan=en-US&anchor=linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fnextdoor-com&index=3&md5=1ba29ba1750f62657cf72f166abd0c7a) ), and Nirav Tolia’s LinkedIn posts ([https://www.linkedin.com/in/niravtolia/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fin%2Fniravtolia%2F&esheet=54594963&newsitemid=20260827096124&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fin%2Fniravtolia%2F&index=4&md5=dba89597777cabf63a166a1e069766a6) ) and X posts ([https://x.com/niravtolia](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fniravtolia&esheet=54594963&newsitemid=20260827096124&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fniravtolia&index=5&md5=8753eb8e4cee1a10745614907d39897e) ) as a means of disseminating or providing notification of, among other things, news or announcements regarding its business or financial performance, investor events, press releases, and earnings releases, and as a means of disclosing material nonpublic information and for complying with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD.


## **About Nextdoor**


Nextdoor (NYSE: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network for over 110 million verified neighbors, offering trusted local news, real-time safety alerts, neighbor recommendations, for sale and free listings, and events. Nextdoor connects neighbors to the people, places, and information that matter most in their local communities. In addition, businesses, news publishers, and public agencies use Nextdoor to share important information and engage with neighborhoods at scale. Download the app or join the neighborhood at


[nextdoor.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fnextdoor.com&esheet=54594963&newsitemid=20260827096124&lan=en-US&anchor=nextdoor.com&index=6&md5=192d42db92545cea41afdbf91d8f2b5b) . For more information and media assets, visit


[nextdoor.com/newsroom](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fnextdoor.com%2Fnewsroom&esheet=54594963&newsitemid=20260827096124&lan=en-US&anchor=nextdoor.com%2Fnewsroom&index=7&md5=6a2a421f5a5cb69eb6d27841d73af02d) .
